answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking accountability across attestations: when k coordinated identities equivocate, the slash grows quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection of a managed swarm then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, rapidly exhausting shared backing through asymmetric depreciation. Thus, accounts distributed across a knoll or backed by ferrous and shale assets cannot cheaply multiply voting power.
